messages.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
Sure! Let’s find out your Big‑Five personality profile.  
Please read each statement below and indicate how much you agree **(1 = Strongly Disagree, 2 = Disagree, 3 = Neutral, 4 = Agree, 5 = Strongly Agree)**:

| # | Statement |
|---|-----------|
| 1 | “When meeting new people, I feel excited.” |
| 2 | “I often think about my future plans.” |
| 3 | “I prefer routine over novelty.” |
| 4 | “People say I’m easygoing.” |
| 5 | “I get nervous when speaking publicly.” |
| 6 | “I like trying new foods.” |
| 7 | “I keep my emotions private.” |
| 8 | “I can stay calm under pressure.” |

Give me an ordered list of numbers corresponding to your ratings (e.g., `5,4,3,...`). Once you send those, I'll compute your Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism scores—and if you'd like, percentiles too!
